title: Compliance Surcharge on Northloop Payments Instant Payout Rates
content:
Active policy violation points on a seller's Seller Performance Standing record raise the instant fee rate of the seller's Northloop Payments instant payouts.

**Rule.** In pricing an instant payout, Northloop adds to the volume-priced rate a compliance rate surcharge of 0.0030 when the seller's standing record carries at least 6 active violation points, 0.0010 when it carries 1 to 5, and nothing when it carries none. The rate so combined is applied once to the payout amount.

| Active violation points on the Seller Performance Standing record | Compliance rate surcharge added |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.0030 |
| 1 to 5 | 0.0010 |
| none | nothing |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical).* 6 active points add 0.0030; 5 add 0.0010; 1 adds 0.0010; 0 adds nothing.
